description: On the table there’s a small stack of colorful plastic plates with assorted plastic utensils on top, and a yellow squeeze bottle off to the right. The left hand holds a red plastic spoon while the right hand presses a blue sponge against it, scrubbing across the spoon’s bowl and along the handle as both hands rotate and reposition the spoon; the right hand then pulls the sponge away while the left hand moves the spoon back and sets it onto the utensil pile on the plates.
